name: Triplane Feature Synthesis
aliases: Triplane Feature Synthesis — EG3D Triplane Synthesis, StyleGAN Triplane Generation
definition: A method to generate expressive 3D features using three orthogonal planes (xy, xz, yz) conditioned on a latent code z, using extra synthesis blocks for disentanglement.
summary: Triplane Feature Synthesis generates 3D features using three orthogonal 2D planes, distinguished by extra synthesis blocks that enable disentanglement and plane-specific kernel attention.
